findings.title: 94% of public package pages serve HTTP 503

measurement.method: uniform random sample, ORDER BY md5(ecosystem||name) LIMIT 50, one sequential GET each

mechanisms.cause: interactive pool is 2 connections with a 250ms admission wait
any single failed sub-read renders the whole page 503
mechanisms.evidence: 21 s.unavailable() call sites (explorer.go 15, dependencies.go 2, failureissuepage.go 2, gaps.go 1, samples.go 1); PackageVersions is a required read

mechanisms.cause: cluster read exceeds the 8s interactive statement ceiling
mechanisms.evidence: EXPLAIN ANALYZE: 76177ms total, 68749ms shared read time, 396 hit / 6261 read = 5.9% hit rate, 9352 rows

findings.expected_fix: push ecosystem predicate + LIMIT into listFailureClusters; render from partial reads; raise CSX_DB_READ_CONNS/READ_WAIT above the resident builder

findings.title: builder pass outruns its interval and holds background connections permanently
76-80% hypervisor CPU steal; not a container limit
findings.not_established: the Lightsail bundle baseline allowance was not read; burst-credit exhaustion is the mechanism consistent with the measurement, not a measured fact

findings.title: 86.3% of live CROSS_PASS labels fail the rule that grants them
findings.expected_fix: persist the author LOCAL_PASS as a receipt so one rule governs, or gate the L4_CROSS_PASS badge on sampleStatusFromReceipts as the MCP surface already does

findings.title: failure_clusters per-package read is the largest DB consumer
causes: no LIMIT and no ecosystem predicate in SQL
six wide JSONB columns cast to text per row

findings.title: builder_purl_coord: non-inlinable multi-CTE SQL function used as an index expression
findings.read_path_explain: Index Only Scan using evidence_agg_builder_coord_idx, Heap Fetches: 5433, 4472ms for 574 rows
findings.attribution: write-path index maintenance, not per-row predicate evaluation
findings.expected_fix: compute the coordinate in Go into a stored column and index the column, or make the function inlinable

findings.title: snapshot upsert has no no-op guard; cluster upsert has one but pays to use it

snapshot_upsert.expected_fix: WHERE compatibility_snapshots.snapshot IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.snapshot

cluster_upsert.expected_fix: compare a digest column, or compare in Go against rows the builder just read, so the conflict read never happens
